ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Drought can induce an increase in abscisic acid (ABA) in plants to reduce water loss, but the mechanism by which drought promotes ABA synthesis is still unclear. Researchers found that a secreted short peptide (C) plays an important role in this process. After treating Arabidopsis roots with trace amounts (0.1 μmol·L-1) of C or ABA respectively, leaf stomatal aperture was measured, and the results are shown in Figure 1 below. According to Figure 1, what effect can both C and ABA exert to reduce water loss?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Drought can induce an increase in abscisic acid (ABA) in plants to reduce water loss, but the mechanism by which drought promotes ABA synthesis is still unclear. Researchers found that a secreted short peptide (C) plays an important role in this process. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Figure 1 is a bar chart, the vertical axis represents the relative value of stomatal aperture, and the horizontal axis represents treatment time. The control bar at 0 h is relatively high; after ABA treatment for 1 h and 3 h, the bar height gradually decreases; after C treatment for 1 h and 3 h, the bar height also decreases. Then reason: The question stem states that after treating Arabidopsis roots with trace amounts of C or ABA, leaf stomatal aperture was measured, while Figure 1 shows that both treatments cause the relative value of leaf stomatal aperture to decrease. Therefore, both C and ABA can reduce water loss by reducing stomatal aperture.
